parameters.help_en: Template content. Note that the total number of characters must not exceed 70. Any excess will be billed as a long text message, with each segment of 67 characters counted as one message. Marketing messages must end with "Reply T to unsubscribe."
parameters.help_zh: 模板内容，请注意控制总字数在70个字以内，超出部分按长短信收费，按67个字为单位记一条短信，必须在结尾添加”回T退订“
parameters.name: content

parameters.help_en: Signature ID. You can obtain a list of signatures with the review status set to Pass by calling ListSignatures, and then retrieve the signature ID
